title: When attachment keeps tightening the grip in the day as it is
issueStatement: The mind keeps clinging to what it cannot finally keep. The pressure is not abstract anymore; it is meeting the ordinary shape of the day.
centralInsight: Guru teaches love without possession and steadiness without denial. Gurbani refuses to treat the ordinary day as spiritually irrelevant.
practicalReflection: Freedom is not numbness. It is steadiness before what usually hooks the mind. Practice holding the gift without claiming authorship over it.
actionPrompt: Practice holding the gift without claiming authorship over it. Keep the response small enough to survive an ordinary day.
